messages:
max: follow-up from the late-night alert storm — want to assign owners for tuning so we don't repeat this. items: 
- noisy disk-iops alerts -> raise threshold + add stabilization window (owner: tara) target: 72h
- dedupe key for api-5xx bursts -> job-level dedupe (owner: diego) target: 1 week
- paging policy: route transient low-sev to slack only, medium to oncall but only daytime (owner: max) target: 48h
please ack and note blockers. tagging @ops-bot to create a tracker.

tara: ack. i'll do disk thresholds. plan: bump to 0.92 and add `for: 5m` stabilization in staging, run 24h watch. will paste rule diff.

diego: taking dedupe. will use `{{job}}:{{error_sig}}` and add a smoke test in alerting-ci. PR by Thu.

max: i'll update paging policy doc and set grandfathering for 14 days. daytime window 09:00-18:00 PT ok?

oncall-svc: FYI i'll adjust rota rules once policy PR merges so daytime routing is enforced.

ops-bot: Task created: https://tasks.company/INFR-4011 "Alert tuning: disk threshold, api dedupe, paging policy" assigned to [tara, diego, max] due 2026-05-22 :white_check_mark:

tara: rule diff for staging: ```
# old
expr: node_disk_io_time_seconds_total{mode!="idle"} > 0.7
# proposed
expr: node_disk_io_time_seconds_total{mode!="idle"} > 0.92
for: 5m
labels:
  severity: medium
```
will monitor dashboards and rollback if noisy.

diego: PR opened for dedupe template and CI smoke job. will validate next Monday.

max: thanks. i'll add these to the postmortem action table and close the tracker when done. final checklist: tara (72h), diego (7d), max (48h). flag if need more time. :thumbsup:
